name: naxxramas
notes: DRAFT: written offline in task B1 from the world database export of map 533 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json: 1052 creature spawns, 80 entries, 248 game objects; sql/base dump of 2026-09-12), the core's naxxramas instance and boss scripts and the server's map 533 navmesh. Not mapped, not live-checked: the GM-invisible walk verifies every point.

The 298 pull groups of the draft are merged to 203 packs on one floor (dz <= 4) chaining within 15 yd with a navmesh path no longer than 2.2x the straight line plus 8 yd, 16 units at most, plus the pull-reach closure of the pack radius plus 3 yd. 23 further packs stand on the ring walkways at z 267-295, unreachable on foot from the hub, and are left out.

The quarters are walked in the order the instance scripts gate them (spider, plague, military, construct) and the frostwyrm lair comes last. Doors that stay shut after a kill are opened by a step; doors the instance opens on a kill are waited for. Vias break the long walks between quarters into server-path hops.

Open at this prep: the construct tail (Gluth's room, the Thaddius pit) and the frostwyrm lair are separate navmesh islands, Gothik's encounter needs more than 10 living players on each side of 181170, and Kel'Thuzad starts only from area trigger 4112; see the prep's blockers.
